caseNameFull: Andy Sunday v. Sidney T. Mallory
summary: Appeal from the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Assistant Attorney General Kearful, Mr. Joseph C. Stone and Mr. J. H. Langley for appellants. Mr. J. W. Zevely for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Reversed with costs, except as to the one-sixth interest conveyed by Andy Sunday, as to which judgment is affirmed, upon the authority of Brader v. James, 246 U. S. 88; Talley v. Burgess, 246 U. S. 104. And see David v. Youngken, 250 Fed. Rep. 208; Harris v. Bell, 250 Fed. Rep. 209.
